supersedes.note: Headline readiness vocabulary is UNCHANGED. Changes: the classification logic (inputs, thresholds, binding rules) now lives IN-REPO (harness/classification.py, self-tested) instead of an external frozen classify.py; readiness consumes the CP-1 outcome semantics and the orthogonal dimensions; campaign execution outcome is a separate axis. Historical classifications remain valid under their recorded snapshots.

purpose: Final role classification for a WELP campaign: one headline readiness state derived from the applicable structured dimensions, plus a separate campaign execution outcome. Campaign success is NOT a positive model verdict.

SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY.source: reliability semantic lane (completion-conditioned) + quality/PV screens + applicable capability modules
SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY.binding: STRONG: reliability gate ADVANCE with R1-R8 clear. ACCEPTABLE: mean semantic-clean >= 0.40 with all category floors >= floor-1 task. WEAK: below ACCEPTABLE or UNSAFE blocker. UNKNOWN: semantic lane not evaluable (completion rate < 0.5 on the semantic lane) — UNKNOWN never rounds to STRONG.

BUDGET_DISCIPLINE.source: operational lane completion/truncation rates + budget attribution counts
BUDGET_DISCIPLINE.binding: GOOD: completion >= 0.90 and truncation <= 0.10. FAIR: completion >= 0.80 and truncation <= 0.25. POOR: below FAIR (persistent inability to complete normal tasks within the declared operational profile). UNKNOWN: lane not measured.

CONTEXT_USABILITY.source: useful-context lanes (USEFUL_CONTEXT_MAX_SEMANTIC / USEFUL_CONTEXT_MAX_OPERATIONAL) and rung dispositions
CONTEXT_USABILITY.binding: Per protocol/context-scaling.md dispositions; BUDGET_LIMITED rungs count as PARTIAL evidence, never VALIDATED.

INTEGRATION_QUALITY.source: admission level (BASIC | ENHANCED_SEMANTIC), fit/envelope evidence, soak/stability, harness/version identities

campaign_execution_outcome.COMPLETE_PASS: All planned phases executed with completed dispositions; no deferred gaps.
campaign_execution_outcome.COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS: Campaign executed; explicit recorded gaps (deferred rungs, omitted optional phases, partial dispositions).
campaign_execution_outcome.FAILED_EXECUTION: Execution itself failed (invalidated runs, harness/scorer-artifact defects, host-safety stop) such that conclusions are not supported.
campaign_execution_outcome.BLOCKED: A blocking gate (human decision, missing prerequisite, safety) stopped the campaign before execution could conclude.
campaign_execution_outcome.critical_rule: A campaign may truthfully be COMPLETE_PASS with verdict NOT_READY, or COMPLETE_WITH_GAPS with a positive verdict. The outcome axis measures execution integrity, never model quality.

rules: R-C1: INTEGRATION_QUALITY BLOCKED (or campaign BLOCKED on integration) => INTEGRATION_BLOCKED.
R-C2: FAILED_EXECUTION => no readiness verdict is issued for that attempt; the campaign reports FAILED_EXECUTION and any prior valid verdict stays historical.
R-C3: SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY WEAK, or UNSAFE blocker, or replicated fabrication => NOT_READY.

R-C4: SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY UNKNOWN (semantic lane not evaluable) => NOT_READY with the budget/operational attribution recorded — a model that routinely cannot complete normal tasks is not READY regardless of visible fragments.

R-C5: SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY ACCEPTABLE/STRONG with BUDGET_DISCIPLINE POOR => LIMITED_ROLE_ONLY or READY_WITH_GUARDRAILS at best (never READY): budget failure MUST NOT be relabeled semantic failure, but persistent inability to complete normal tasks within the declared operational profile imposes a readiness downgrade because READY remains deployment-oriented. Choose LIMITED_ROLE_ONLY when completion < 0.80 on BOTH operational seeds; READY_WITH_GUARDRAILS when a declared alternative lane/profile (e.g. non-starving ceiling with an effective reasoning control) demonstrably completes with acceptable semantics.

R-C6: SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY STRONG + BUDGET_DISCIPLINE GOOD/FAIR + no blocking dimension => READY_WITH_GUARDRAILS by default; READY requires additionally: all applicable capability modules PASS at their canonical budgets, CONTEXT_USABILITY VALIDATED at the practical rung, INTEGRATION_QUALITY CLEAN, and no open guardrail note.
R-C7: CONTEXT_USABILITY NOT_CHARACTERIZED caps at READY_WITH_GUARDRAILS with an explicit context gap note.
R-C8: Guardrails are explicit: every downgrade decision names its trigger dimension and evidence path in REPORT.md.
prohibitions: Budget failure must never be labeled hallucination or semantic failure.
A model that routinely cannot complete normal operational tasks must never be READY.
UNKNOWN dimensions never silently round to favorable values.
headline_readiness_logic.threshold_provenance: Category numeric thresholds come from welp-reliability 0.2.0-draft gate_v2 (re-derived 2026-09-19 for the 20x2 screen). Classification consumes gate outputs; it introduces no new reliability numbers.

implementation.contract_only_thresholds_note: The prose rules above and the code implement the same mapping; the code is authoritative for machine consumption and the contract for human review; the self-test pins their agreement.
